companyOverview.intro: HAVA is the flagship brand of Haryrock Engineering Pvt. Ltd., based at MIDC Pimpri, Pune. We design, machine, assemble, test, and ship our own pneumatic rock drills, drilling spares, and related equipment used across mining and infrastructure projects worldwide. When you buy from HAVA, you're buying directly from the people who build it — giving you direct access to our manufacturing team, genuine spare parts, and full accountability.
companyOverview.brandStory: HAVA stands for precision, reliability, and manufacturing excellence. Born from decades of hands-on experience supplying mining and construction teams in some of the world's toughest environments, the HAVA brand was formally established in 1999. Today, HAVA products are trusted in 20+ countries — from deep underground mines in Scandinavia to open-pit quarries in Africa, from tunnelling projects in the Middle East to construction sites across India.

processChart.title: Eight Stages. Zero Compromise.
processChart.body: Every HAVA product — without exception — passes through all eight manufacturing stages. Each stage is documented, quality-checked, and signed off before the next begins. This is what ISO 9001:2015 process discipline looks like in practice.
processChart.note: Every unit · Every time · No exceptions — ISO 9001:2015 Certified

s1.label: Raw Material Intake & Verification
s1.title: Material Intake & Quality Check
s1.body: All raw materials — steel billets, alloy bars, castings, components — verified against material specifications before entering production. Substandard material rejected at intake. Full traceability maintained throughout.
s1.activities: Grade check · Dimensional verification · Supplier cert review · Traceability tagging

s2.label: CNC Precision Machining
s2.title: Multi-Axis Precision Manufacturing
s2.body: Advanced multi-axis CNC machining centres produce all components to exact dimensional specifications. Every dimension is machine-verified — not manually estimated. This is the foundation of HAVA's consistent quality across every production run.
s2.activities: Turning · Boring · Milling · Threading · Surface grinding · CNC dimensional verification

s3.label: Heat Treatment
s3.title: Hardening, Tempering & Surface Treatment
s3.body: In-house heat treatment achieves the required hardness, wear resistance, and fatigue strength. Piston, cylinder, rifle bar, and high-stress components are heat-treated to specific hardness specifications critical for rock drilling performance.
s3.activities: Case hardening · Through hardening · Tempering · Hardness verification

s4.label: Grinding
s4.title: Surface Finishing & Tight Tolerances
s4.body: Precision grinding ensures all mating surfaces, bores, and shafts meet the tight tolerances required for smooth assembly and long service life. Surface finish is verified to specification before components proceed to assembly.
s4.activities: Cylindrical grinding · Surface grinding · Internal grinding · Finish verification

s5.label: Quality Control & Testing
s5.title: Multi-Point Inspection + Functional Performance Test
s5.body: Every assembled unit goes through structured multi-point QC inspection — dimensional verification, visual checks, component-level confirmation — then into the testing bay. Air pressure applied, impact rate, rotation, flushing, and all controls verified. Results documented. No unit dispatched without a passed test.
s5.activities: Dimensional inspection · Leak test · Rotation check · Impact rate · Air consumption test

s6.label: Accept & Testing
s6.title: Final Acceptance Check
s6.body: Units that pass QC are formally accepted into finished goods. A final verification pass confirms all specifications are met — performance, dimensional, and visual. Rejected units are returned for rework; no exceptions to acceptance criteria.
s6.activities: Acceptance sign-off · Performance validation · Visual inspection · Rework loop if needed

s7.label: Painting & Packing
s7.title: Finish & Protection
s7.body: Accepted units are cleaned, primed, and painted to HAVA's standard finish. Components are individually packed with protective wrapping and placed in export-grade packaging to prevent damage in transit.
s7.activities: Surface cleaning · Painting & drying · Component wrapping · Export-grade packing

s8.label: Dispatch
s8.title: Export-Ready Packaging & Documentation
s8.body: Cleared units are dispatched with full documentation — packing lists, commercial invoices, certificates of origin — prepared and verified before release. Every shipment tracked to the customer. No unit leaves without complete paperwork.
s8.activities: Documentation prep · Invoice & cert of origin · Shipment release · Tracking to customer

qcStandards.title: What We Inspect — And When
qcStandards.body: Every process follows documented procedures under ISO 9001:2015 — regularly audited by V3 Quality Certification Pvt. Ltd.

r2.check: All critical dimensions against drawing specification

r4.check: Surface finish and dimensional tolerance post-grinding
